chapters.title: Scarcity, Choice, and Opportunity Cost
topics: Scarcity: Limited resources relative to unlimited wants
Trade-offs: Choosing one option means giving up another
Opportunity cost: Value of the next best alternative given up
Factors of production: Land, labor, capital, and entrepreneurship
Scarcity vs. shortage: Scarcity is permanent, shortage is temporary

chapters.title: Production Possibilities Curve
topics: Production Possibilities Curve (PPC): Graph showing trade-offs between two goods
PPC interpretation: Points on, inside, and outside the curve
Opportunity cost calculation: Using PPC to determine what is given up
Law of increasing opportunity cost: Why the PPC is typically bowed outward
Economic growth: Shifts in the PPC due to changes in resources or technology
Economic efficiency: Productive efficiency vs. allocative efficiency

chapters.title: Comparative Advantage and Trade
topics: Absolute advantage: Ability to produce more of a good with the same resources
Comparative advantage: Ability to produce a good at lower opportunity cost
Specialization: Focusing production on goods where you have comparative advantage
Gains from trade: How specialization and trade benefit all parties
Terms of trade: Acceptable exchange rates between trading partners

chapters.title: Economic Systems
topics: Traditional economy: Decisions based on customs and traditions
Command economy: Central authority makes economic decisions
Market economy: Decisions made by individuals and firms through price signals
Mixed economy: Combination of market mechanisms and government intervention
Property rights: Legal ownership and control over resources and goods

chapters.title: Marginal Analysis
topics: Marginal benefit: Additional benefit from one more unit
Marginal cost: Additional cost from one more unit
Decision rule: MB = MC for optimal decisions
Rational decision-making and resource allocation

chapters.title: Demand
topics: Law of demand: Inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded
Determinants of demand (shifters): Income, tastes, prices of related goods, expectations, number of buyers
Change in demand vs. change in quantity demanded

chapters.title: Supply
topics: Law of supply: Direct relationship between price and quantity supplied
Determinants of supply (shifters): Input prices, technology, expectations, number of sellers, government policies
Change in supply vs. change in quantity supplied

chapters.title: Market Equilibrium
topics: Equilibrium price and quantity
Surplus and shortage
Effects of shifts in supply and/or demand

chapters.title: Price Controls
topics: Price ceiling: Maximum legal price, potential shortages
Price floor: Minimum legal price, potential surpluses
Deadweight loss from price controls

chapters.title: Elasticity
topics: Price elasticity of demand: Responsiveness of quantity demanded to price changes
Price elasticity of supply: Responsiveness of quantity supplied to price changes
Income elasticity and cross-price elasticity
Elastic vs. inelastic demand and supply

chapters.title: Consumer and Producer Surplus
topics: Consumer surplus: Difference between willingness to pay and actual price
Producer surplus: Difference between price received and minimum acceptable price
Allocative efficiency at equilibrium
